test_series_hist: test the pandas Series.hist method to generate histograms with configurable bins, grid, and figsize
test_dataframe_hist: test the pandas DataFrame.hist method to generate histograms for multiple columns with layout and sharex options
test_grouped_hist: test the _grouped_hist function to create grouped histograms by a categorical column with layout control
test_histtype_argument: test the histtype argument (bar, barstacked, step, stepfilled) to verify patch fill behavior in histograms
test_hist_legend: test the legend parameter in Series and DataFrame hist methods to verify legend labels with by and column arguments
